svg.aria-label: Two fanout models. Fanout on write (push): a new post goes through the fanout service into each friend's precomputed feed, up to 5,000 cache writes, so reading a feed is a single fast lookup. Fanout on read (pull): when a reader opens the app, the posts of every friend are fetched and merged newest first, so no work is wasted on inactive users but reads are slower. The chapter uses a hybrid: push for most users, pull for celebrities.
svg.title: Fanout on write vs read
